public class Intake extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
Controls the ground intake mechanism, which consists of two independent motors:
  • Roller motor (m_intakeMotor) â€” spins intake wheels to pull notes from the floor into the hopper. Open-loop, set by setIntakeSpeed(double).
  • Deploy motor (m_intakeDeployMotor) â€” rotates the intake arm up or down. Open-loop, set by deployIntake(double).

Both motors operate in open-loop (duty-cycle percent output). There is no position or velocity closed-loop on this subsystem â€” the driver holds the deploy at a fixed speed while the intake is active.

  • Method Details

    • periodic

      public void periodic()
      Publishes telemetry and seeds CTRE simulation state each loop.

      In simulation, the CTRE Phoenix 6 sim state is seeded with velocity and position values derived from the commanded duty cycle and a nominal free-speed assumption. This makes SmartDashboard signals display realistic values even without physical motors.

    • deployIntake

      public void deployIntake(double speed)
      Sets the deploy arm motor duty cycle to hold the arm at the commanded position.

      Note: this does not extend or retract the arm to a specific angle â€” it applies a constant duty-cycle output to resist gravity and hold the arm deployed while the intake is active. Typically called with a small positive value (e.g., 0.15) from RunIntake.

      Parameters:
      speed - Duty cycle in [âˆ’1, 1]. Positive rotates toward the deployed (down) position.
